name: comp-125
title: Image Upload Button
description: A small avatar-style uploader: an outline square placeholder and an Upload image button. Choosing a file fills the square with a preview, relabels the button and reveals the filename and a Remove link.
use: A profile or settings form needs one image with a thumbnail, a change action and an easy remove.
avoid: It takes a single image with no size or type guidance and needs the file-upload hook copied alongside it.
a11y: Preview, file input and Remove are labelled and the filename is announced; the placeholder glyph is hidden as decoration. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark rounded square holding a faint user glyph sits beside a light rounded Upload image button on a near-black stage. After a pick, the square becomes a blue gradient thumbnail, the button reads Change image, and a grey filename with a red Remove link appears below.
behaves: Clicking the button opens the file picker; on selection the placeholder swaps for the image, the button changes its label and the filename plus Remove link appear. Remove clears everything back to the placeholder.
customise: No props: the accepted type, the button labels and the credit link are fixed, so different rules or wording mean editing the file.
weight: light: One button, a small preview square and a hidden file input.
demo: The filename "cover-1.png", the labels Upload image and Change image, and the "Basic image uploader" credit.
polishWhy: Clear empty and filled states with an obvious remove action; a demo credit line sits in the flow.
